name: Saimin Musou
source:
"Make friends instantly with the power of hypnosis!"
said a dubious advertisement for a strange ring.
So I bought it. It turned out to be real!?

The protagonist of the game is in his sexual peak, but still hasn't had sex. All of a sudden, he has unparalleled hypnotic power in his hand!

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE073168.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“用催眠的力量，瞬间交到朋友！”
一个奇怪的戒指的可疑广告说。
所以我买了它。原来是真的！？

游戏的主角正处于性高潮，但仍未发生性行为。忽然间，他的手中就拥有了无与伦比的催眠之力！
